Theorem
[Morrey embedding] 1. ch7:7.17\group ch07-sobolev-spaces Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0175, gilbarg-trudinger:page-0176 Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0176 Let $p>n$, $\gamma =1-n/p$, and $u\in W_0^{1,p}(\Omega )$. Then $u\in C^\gamma (\overline\Omega )$ and, for every ball $B_R$, \begin{equation} \tag {7.42} \operatorname *{osc}_{\Omega \cap B_R}u \leq C R^\gamma \| Du\| _p, \qquad C=C(n,p). \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch Apply (7.41) and (7.34) on a ball, with $S=\Omega =B_R$, $q=\infty $, and $\mu =1/n$. The resulting estimate for $|u-u_B|$ at two points gives (7.42).

□
